About.storyTitle: Over 2 years of excellence in dentistry
About.storyP1: TehnicalDent was born in 2024 from the desire to create a space where high-quality dental medicine meets genuine patient care. Our founder laid the foundation for a clinic where every treatment is performed with precision, every patient is heard, and every smile matters.
About.storyP2: Over the years, we have consistently invested in cutting-edge technology and continuous training of our team. We have brought to Chișinău techniques and equipment that were previously available only in Western European clinics.
About.storyP3: Today, TehnicalDent is recognized as one of the leading clinics in Moldova, with thousands of satisfied patients and a reputation built on concrete results and trust-based relationships.

Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy of the TehnicalDent dental clinic. Information about the collection, use, and protection of personal data, including in conversations on Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
Privacy.s1Text: TehnicalDent, headquartered at Str. Sarmizegetusa 24/1, Chișinău, Republic of Moldova, is committed to protecting the confidentiality of your personal data. This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect the personal information you provide to us. It applies to the tehnicaldent.com website, the contact and appointment forms, and the conversations you have with us on Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp.
Privacy.s2Intro: In the course of our activity, we may collect the following categories of personal data:
Privacy.s2L1Text: name, surname, phone number, email address
Privacy.s2L2Text: dental medical history, X-rays, treatment plans, information about oral health status
Privacy.s2L3Text: messages sent through the contact form, appointment preferences, requested service
Privacy.s2L4Text: the identifier Meta assigns to your conversation with our page (PSID for Messenger, IGSID for Instagram) or your phone number in the case of WhatsApp, your public profile name, the content of the messages sent and received, the technical message identifier, and its date and time
Privacy.s2L5Text: IP address, browser type, device information (automatically collected when visiting the website)
Privacy.s3Intro: Your personal data is collected and processed for the following purposes:
Privacy.s3L1: Scheduling and managing consultations and treatments
Privacy.s3L2: Providing the requested dental medical services
Privacy.s3L3: Communicating with you regarding appointments, treatments, and recommendations
Privacy.s3L4: Replying to the messages we receive via Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp
Privacy.s3L5: Improving the quality of our services
Privacy.s3L6: Complying with legal obligations regarding medical documentation
Privacy.s4Text: The processing of your personal data is carried out based on the following legal grounds: your explicit consent (given by completing the contact form, by starting a conversation on Messenger, Instagram, or WhatsApp, or upon presentation at the clinic), the performance of a medical services contract and the steps taken prior to entering into it, the operator's legal obligations regarding medical documentation, and the operator's legitimate interest in improving services.
Privacy.s5Title: 5. Messaging via Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and WhatsApp
Privacy.s5Intro: When you write to us on Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, or WhatsApp, we receive through the Meta platforms the minimum data needed to reply to you. This section explains exactly what we do with it:
Privacy.s5L1Text: your identifier, valid only for the conversation with our page (PSID/IGSID), or your phone number in the case of WhatsApp, your public profile name, and the content of the messages. We do not request and do not receive your email address, friend list, photos, or any other information from your Facebook or Instagram profile.
Privacy.s5L2Text: solely to answer your question, to book or change an appointment, and to keep the conversation history so that the colleague who picks up your request can continue the discussion.
Privacy.s5L3Text: we do not sell, license, or purchase this data, we do not use it for advertising or to build user profiles, we do not combine it with data obtained from other sources, and we do not use it for automated decisions about people.
Privacy.s5L4Text: only authorized clinic staff, through individual accounts. Each new message triggers an internal notification to the team, in a private channel used strictly to pick up requests quickly.
Privacy.s5L5Text: conversations are kept for at most 24 months after the last message, and are deleted afterwards. We delete them sooner if you ask us to.
Privacy.s5L6Label: The role of the Meta platforms:
Privacy.s5L6Text: the conversation also runs on Meta's infrastructure (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), and the processing carried out by Meta is governed by its own policies, over which we have no control.
Privacy.s5Note: We recommend that you do not send detailed medical information or sensitive documents through messaging. For those, we are available at the clinic or by email.
Privacy.s6Text: Your personal data is stored in secure systems and is protected by appropriate technical and organizational measures against unauthorized access, loss, or destruction. Access is restricted through individual accounts, with permissions limited to each person's role. Medical documentation is retained for the period required by applicable legislation; messages received through the contact form and conversations from the messaging channels are kept for at most 24 months after the last interaction. If you identify a security issue in our website or services, please write to us at the address in the Contact section — we review and remediate such reports as a priority.
Privacy.s7Text: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We share it only with the providers that help us operate the service — website and database hosting, the email service, the messaging platforms you write to us on, and the service through which our team receives internal notifications — which are required to process the data solely on our instructions and in accordance with this policy; with partner dental laboratories where necessary for prosthetic work; and with the competent authorities where applicable legislation requires it.
Privacy.s8Intro: You can ask us to delete your data at any time, whether you are a patient of the clinic or have only sent us a message on Messenger, Instagram, or WhatsApp. The procedure is as follows:
Privacy.s8L1: Send a request to the email address below with the subject “Data deletion”, or write to us directly in the conversation on Messenger, Instagram, or WhatsApp.
Privacy.s8L2: State the name you contacted us under and the channel you used (Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, contact form) or your phone number, so that we can identify the records.
Privacy.s8L3: We confirm receipt of the request and delete the data within 30 days at the latest.
Privacy.s8L4: The only exception is data that medical documentation legislation requires us to retain; in that case we will tell you exactly what remains stored and for how long.
Privacy.s8Note: Deleting the conversation from the Messenger, Instagram, or WhatsApp app, or uninstalling it, does not automatically delete the copy of the messages in our system — please use the procedure above.
Privacy.s9Intro: As a data subject, you have the following rights:
Privacy.s9L1Text: you can request information about the personal data we hold
Privacy.s9L2Text: you can request correction of inaccurate data
Privacy.s9L3Text: you can request deletion of data, subject to legal obligations
Privacy.s9L4Text: you can request limitation of data processing
Privacy.s9L5Text: you can request transfer of data to another controller
Privacy.s9L6Text: you can object to data processing in certain situations
Privacy.s10Text: Our website may use technical cookies necessary for the proper functioning of web pages. We do not use marketing or user behavior tracking cookies.

implantologie.title: Dental Implantology
implantologie.shortDesc: Complete restoration of missing teeth with state-of-the-art dental implants, providing natural functionality and aesthetics.
implantologie.overview: A dental implant is an artificial titanium root surgically placed in the jawbone. A ceramic crown is mounted over this implant that looks and functions exactly like a natural tooth. The procedure is performed under local anesthesia and is virtually painless.
implantologie.process: The implant process begins with a detailed evaluation, including 3D computed tomography for precise planning. The actual procedure takes between 30 and 60 minutes per implant. After an osseointegration period of 3-6 months, the permanent crown is placed.
implantologie.recovery: Recovery after implantation is usually quick. In the first few days, slight discomfort and swelling may occur, manageable with prescribed medication. Most patients return to normal activities within 2-3 days.
implantologie.benefits: Exceptional durability — can last a lifetime with proper care|Natural appearance and complete functionality|Prevention of bone resorption|Does not affect adjacent teeth|Superior comfort compared to removable dentures

ortodontie.title: Orthodontics
ortodontie.shortDesc: Correction of malocclusions and teeth alignment with modern dental appliances, including invisible solutions for adults.
ortodontie.overview: Modern orthodontics offers multiple treatment options, from classic fixed braces to clear aligners. The choice of method depends on the complexity of the case and the patient's preferences.
ortodontie.process: Treatment begins with a detailed consultation and specific analyses (X-rays, photographs, digital models). Based on these, a personalized treatment plan is developed. Treatment duration varies between 6 months and 3 years.
ortodontie.recovery: Orthodontic appliances require an adjustment period of 1-2 weeks. Regular check-ups are essential for adjustments and progress monitoring.
ortodontie.benefits: Aesthetic and harmonious smile|Improved chewing function|Prevention of premature tooth wear|Easier oral hygiene|Correction of speech problems

estetica-dentara.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
estetica-dentara.shortDesc: Smile transformation through veneers, professional whitening and aesthetic contouring for a natural, luminous look.
estetica-dentara.overview: Each cosmetic treatment begins with a detailed analysis of the smile and facial features. The goal is to achieve a natural, harmonious result that complements the patient's physiognomy.
estetica-dentara.process: Depending on the chosen treatment, the procedure can last from a single session (professional whitening) to several weeks (ceramic veneers). We use premium materials and cutting-edge technology.
estetica-dentara.recovery: Most cosmetic procedures have minimal recovery. Temporary dental sensitivity may occur after whitening, but disappears within a few days.
estetica-dentara.benefits: Whiter and brighter smile|Correction of tooth shape and size|Natural and long-lasting results|Increased self-confidence|Minimally invasive procedures

chirurgie-orala.title: Oral Surgery
chirurgie-orala.shortDesc: Specialized surgical interventions for complex extractions, cyst treatment and implant preparation.
chirurgie-orala.overview: Our oral surgery team has extensive experience in all types of interventions, using minimally invasive techniques for quick recovery and maximum comfort.
chirurgie-orala.process: Each intervention is preceded by a complete evaluation and detailed planning. We use state-of-the-art local anesthesia and, upon request, conscious sedation for anxious patients.
chirurgie-orala.recovery: Recovery time varies depending on the complexity of the intervention. We provide detailed post-operative instructions and are available for any questions.
chirurgie-orala.benefits: Minimally invasive techniques|Quick recovery|Effective anesthesia|Post-operative monitoring|Experience in complex cases

protetica-dentara.title: Dental Prosthetics
protetica-dentara.shortDesc: Restoration of functionality and aesthetics through crowns, bridges and dental prostheses made from premium materials.
protetica-dentara.overview: We use CAD/CAM technology for designing and manufacturing prosthetic work with maximum precision. Materials used are premium ceramics and zirconia, ensuring durability and aesthetics.
protetica-dentara.process: After tooth preparation, a digital impression is taken for fabrication. Production time is 5-10 days, depending on complexity. Temporary restorations are applied during the waiting period.
protetica-dentara.recovery: Adapting to new prosthetic work takes a few days. Adjustment check-ups ensure perfect comfort.
protetica-dentara.benefits: Natural and aesthetic appearance|Biocompatible materials|Long-lasting durability|Complete functionality|Digital precision technology

endodontie.title: Endodontics
endodontie.shortDesc: Root canal treatment and saving affected teeth through precise and painless procedures with modern instruments.
endodontie.overview: We use microscopy and state-of-the-art rotary instruments for precise and efficient treatments. Modern anesthesia ensures a completely painless procedure.
endodontie.process: Treatment involves cleaning and disinfecting the root canals, followed by their hermetic filling. Depending on complexity, it can be performed in a single session or in several.
endodontie.recovery: After treatment, mild sensitivity may exist for a few days. A root canal treated tooth usually requires a crown for long-term protection.
endodontie.benefits: Saving the natural tooth|Elimination of infection and pain|Painless procedure|State-of-the-art technology|High success rate

parodontologie.title: Periodontics
parodontologie.shortDesc: Treatment of gum and periodontal conditions to maintain the health of the teeth's supporting tissues.
parodontologie.overview: Periodontal disease is one of the most common oral conditions and the leading cause of tooth loss in adults. Early diagnosis and treatment are essential.
parodontologie.process: Treatment includes professional cleaning, subgingival scaling and, in advanced cases, regenerative surgical procedures. Maintaining results requires regular check-ups.
parodontologie.recovery: Recovery varies depending on the severity of the condition and the type of treatment. Rigorous oral hygiene at home is essential for success.
parodontologie.benefits: Stopping disease progression|Reducing inflammation and bleeding|Preventing tooth loss|Improving overall oral health|Personalized treatments

pedodontie.title: Pediatric Dentistry
pedodontie.shortDesc: Specialized dentistry for children in a friendly environment that turns the dental visit into a positive experience.
pedodontie.overview: Our environment is specially designed to be welcoming and calming for young patients. Our team has experience working with children and uses age-appropriate communication techniques.
pedodontie.process: The first visit includes familiarization with the office and equipment. Treatments are carried out patiently, at the child's pace, for a positive experience.
pedodontie.recovery: Children usually recover very quickly after treatments. We offer advice for parents regarding home care.
pedodontie.benefits: Child-friendly environment|Prevention and education|Painless treatments|Building healthy habits|Positive dental experiences
